data.detail: Never got off the home page. Eight presses (Reject all on the cookie box, then the red Donate in the top bar) were all refused with "the page changed; look again". The rotating news strip under the hero changes every few seconds, which is faster than a look-then-act round trip, so no action could ever land. Zero steps used, patience still 6. This is mostly a harness limit (the change detection counts carousel rotation as a page change), but the auto-rotating strip behind the cookie box is a real nuisance for a slow reader as well.
